claims.statement: PV degradation and component failure affect lifetime energy yield and economic outcomes, but the proposed willingness to pay for a standardized small-site evidence pack remains untested.
Asset owners, buyers, lenders, insurers, and repowering contractors are plausible budget holders at a transaction or fault trigger, but no Polish buyer commitment or budget size is evidenced.
The founder could pursue nonexclusive referral contracts with installers and decision intermediaries, beginning with a consenting family-firm pilot; no distribution right is currently controlled.

IEA PVPS identifies multiple field failure and degradation modes and the need for models that account for local and operational conditions, supporting a structured-evidence need rather than any specific product demand.

commercial_mechanics.budget_owner: Asset manager, business owner, technical due-diligence lead, claims lead, or credit officer
commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: Use a deliberately small-asset, fixed-price scope, remain independent of replacement equipment, and preserve portable evidence usable across bidders
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: Referral partner until the asset owner signs the diagnostic engagement
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Installer service calls and lender, insurer, broker, or owner referrals

fully_loaded_economics.acquisition_cost: Referral share and partner enablement; target below 15% of pack revenue
fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Deposit on booking and balance on delivery; field subcontractors paid on normal invoice terms
fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Unvalidated target 45-65% on standardized packs after subcontracted inspection and review
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Standard data intake and modeling plus a bounded field checklist; complex engineering is explicitly out of scope or subcontracted
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: Professional indemnity, contracts, secure evidence storage, calibrated equipment, accounting, and technical-quality review
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Hypothesis: 2500-7500 PLN per small-commercial site, with separately priced field tests and optional 0.5-1.0% transaction-success fee where lawful
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: Inspector or electrician time, travel, thermal imaging, data extraction, specialist review, and professional liability allocation

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: Engineering consultancies, OEM service teams, and larger installers can offer fuller reports or bundle inspection into repowering bids
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: Paid event is delivery and acceptance of a scoped evidence pack; measurable loss is a delayed or mis-scoped repair, repowering, refinance, sale, or warranty decision caused by inadequate evidence
commercial_mechanics.payer: PV asset owner, buyer, repowering contractor, lender, or insurer
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: Observed underperformance, safety alert, inverter failure, expiring warranty, refinancing, asset sale, or planned repowering
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: A new transaction, material fault, annual portfolio review, or post-repair verification creates repeat demand

contrary_evidence: Many small systems may be cheaper to repair or replace using an installer quote than to commission independent diligence.
Lenders and insurers may demand accredited engineers and bespoke reports, eliminating the economics of a standardized pack.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: Proposed nonexclusive referral and distribution agreement with a defined evidence-pack scope, fee, consent flow, and liability boundary
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Acquire customers through independent electricians, owner associations, asset marketplaces, or direct outreach to public installation registries where lawful
critical_control_point.current_owner: Installers, asset owners, lenders, brokers, and insurers; the founder has no current right beyond a possible family-firm pilot
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: Referral partner until the asset owner signs the diagnostic engagement
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: The parents' renewable-installation firm offers a lawful route to test the template and workflow with consenting ordinary customers; it provides neither exclusive distribution nor undocumented customer data.
critical_control_point.launch_controller: Each referral partner and the asset owner consenting to data and site access
critical_control_point.renewal: Annual renewal based on completed packs, acceptance rate, and referral economics
critical_control_point.subject: Referral access at the moment an installed PV system needs repair, repowering, sale, insurance, or refinancing evidence

economics.acquisition_route: Referral at service, fault, sale, refinance, warranty, or repowering events
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Regional pack volume can fund a national partner network and proprietary failure models; a 5m PLN path likely requires portfolio contracts or acquisition within 4-6 years, not one-off local audits alone
economics.founder_time: Up to five hours per day while field collection is delegated under a fixed checklist
economics.gross_margin_basis: Pack fee less inspection subcontractor, travel, equipment use, specialist review, insurance, and channel share
economics.payback: Target immediate contribution per paid pack and under six months on a partner integration
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 2500-7500 PLN per evidence pack plus separately quoted field tests
economics.retention_or_repeat: Event-driven repeat for portfolios, with optional annual condition updates

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Normalized failure, repair, and realized-yield outcomes create model calibration by equipment cohort and operating environment
fingerprint.customer: Owners, acquirers, lenders, insurers, and repowering contractors for small-commercial rooftop PV
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Nonexclusive referrals from installers, electrical inspectors, lenders, insurers, and asset brokers
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Fixed-scope remote-plus-field diagnostic pack with optional update and transaction-success fee
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Asset owner, buyer, or contractor pays when a standardized site evidence pack is delivered and accepted for a defined decision
fingerprint.problem_trigger: An aging or underperforming system reaches a refinance, sale, warranty, insurance, or repowering decision without finance-grade evidence

founder_fit: Uses data analysis for remaining-yield estimation and structured decision evidence
Family-sector familiarity and a lawful test relationship shorten learning without requiring confidential resources
A fixed scope can be standardized and delegated to qualified field technicians
Initial capital and daily founder time can remain within the stated constraints
risks: An incorrect remaining-life estimate can cause financial loss or safety exposure
Channel partners may use the pack as unpaid lead qualification and keep the customer
Field travel can destroy margins outside dense regional clusters
OEM-specific data access and undocumented repairs can reduce model reliability

structural_signature.commercial_model_descriptor: fixed scope finance ready pv condition and repowering evidence pack
structural_signature.control_point_descriptor: referral presence at pv repair sale refinance warranty and repowering triggers
structural_signature.critical_dependency_descriptor: repeatable installer lender insurer broker or asset owner referrals

structure.control_point: repeatable distribution inside installer and asset-decision workflows
structure.critical_dependency: trusted referral channels that expose systems at a real transaction or repair trigger

thesis: Future operating state (2033): aging small-commercial solar roofs are routinely repowered, refinanced, or selectively repaired. Missing coordination mechanism: a low-cost independent evidence pack that converts fragmented inverter logs, visual and thermal inspections, warranty status, safety findings, and remaining-yield estimates into a decision a lender, insurer, buyer, or owner can accept.
title: PV Repowering Evidence Pack
uncertainties: Number and timing of Polish small-commercial systems reaching genuine repowering or refinance decisions
Evidence standard acceptable to lenders, insurers, buyers, and warranty counterparties
Availability and quality of historical inverter and maintenance data
Professional qualification and liability requirements for each report use
